mapper.select: SELECT * FROM recurring_plan ORDER BY id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO recurring_plan (title, plan_type, repeat_cycle, start_date, end_date, amount, attribution, category_id, account_id, target_account_id, card_id, loan_id, active) VALUES (#{title}, #{planType}, #{repeatCycle}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{amount}, #{attribution}, #{categoryId}, #{accountId}, #{targetAccountId}, #{cardId}, #{loanId}, #{active})
mapper.update: UPDATE recurring_plan SET title=#{title}, plan_type=#{planType}, repeat_cycle=#{repeatCycle}, start_date=#{startDate}, end_date=#{endDate}, amount=#{amount}, attribution=#{attribution}, category_id=#{categoryId}, account_id=#{accountId}, target_account_id=#{targetAccountId}, card_id=#{cardId}, loan_id=#{loanId}, active=#{active}, updated_at=now() WHERE id=#{id}
